lines.zh: 我走在田里，稻草掉火星。
lines.en: I cross the field dropping sparks from my straw.

lines.zh: 每踩一步，土就焦一小块。
lines.en: Every step scorches a small patch of soil.
I walk crooked; one side of me is lighter.
My frame creaks like an old door hinge.

lines.zh: 我走过麦子，麦子卷了边。
lines.en: The wheat curls at the edges when I pass.
Smoke trails behind me like a tail.
I move slowly so my frame stays together.

lines.zh: 脚下的草先黄，再烧起来。
lines.en: Grass yellows under me, then catches fire.

lines.zh: 风一吹，我的稻草全歪了。
lines.en: Wind bends all my straw to one side.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，火星落了一地。
lines.en: I lift a foot and sparks rain down.
I have burned this path once before.

lines.zh: 木杆戳进泥里，拔出来带火。
lines.en: My stake pulls from mud still glowing.

lines.zh: 我避开那滩水，绕了远路。
lines.en: I detour around that puddle of water.

lines.zh: 靠近鸡舍时，我放轻了脚。
lines.en: Near the chicken coop, I soften my step.

lines.zh: 我踩进浅水，白烟一下冒起来。
lines.en: I step in shallow water, and white steam bursts up.

lines.zh: 我拖着木杆走，草茎被烧断。
lines.en: I drag my pole along, and grass stems burn through.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，稻草自己在烧。
lines.en: I stand still and my straw burns by itself.
No crow dares land on me.

lines.zh: 火苗从我的手心钻出来。
lines.en: A small flame pushes from my palm.

lines.zh: 我听见雨在很远的地方。
lines.en: I hear rain somewhere far away.

lines.zh: 麻雀绕着田飞，不进这块。
lines.en: Sparrows circle the field but will not enter.
I bow and sparks fall down my collar.
I count the straw I have left.
The pond out there glares too brightly.
Insects bore through the wood inside me.
I raise one hand and let it drop.
The wind shifted, so I turned around.

lines.zh: 有人在地头堆了新稻草。
lines.en: Someone stacked fresh straw at the field's edge.
I wait for the sky to cloud over.

lines.zh: 火不烧我的骨头，只烧外面。
lines.en: Fire takes my outer layer, not my bones.
You smell of water—keep your distance.
I stare at that bucket in your hands.

lines.zh: 你站在田边，来收麦的吗？
lines.en: You stand at the edge—come to take the wheat?

lines.zh: 你的影子拖得长，我的短。
lines.en: Your shadow drags long; mine stays short.
Do not bring that bottle any closer.

lines.zh: 我认得你，你烧过这块地。
lines.en: I know you; you burned this field before.
You smile as though watching a show.
Your clothes are dry. That is good.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，脖子咔嚓响。
lines.en: I look up and my neck clicks.
What is that bottle in your hand?
Straw is cut through; the fire holds.
I lost a hand and still I burn.
You struck the frame, not me.
That cut tilts me to the left.
Sparks splashed your face. My apologies.
It does not hurt; I am just short of straw.

lines.zh: 痛的时候，火会烧得更旺。
lines.en: When it hurts, the fire burns brighter.
You have split my chest open.
I swayed twice and did not fall.

lines.zh: 再砍，我就散成一地火星。
lines.en: Cut again and I scatter into embers.

lines.zh: 给我一把干草，我就安静。
lines.en: Give me dry straw and I will quiet down.

lines.zh: 你手里有油吗？我闻到了。
lines.en: Is that oil? I smell it on you.
Lend me that torch—just for a moment.
I refuse wet straw; bring it dry.
That piece of firewood beats any bread.
Light it, and I will follow you.
I am hungry, but it is the fire that starves.

lines.zh: 稻草塞紧些，我能站更久。
lines.en: Packed tighter, my straw lasts longer.
Do not feed me water; that would harm me.
This pile of stalks will burn three days.
Bump me and your clothes singe first.

lines.zh: 退开，火星落到你袖子上了。
lines.en: Back off—sparks are on your sleeve.
I cannot stand steady; do not push.
Wood knocks wood, and the sound is dull.
You are standing on my fallen straw.

lines.zh: 我侧身让路，火苗跟着晃。
lines.en: I step aside and my flames sway with me.

lines.zh: 别用盾顶我，会留下焦痕。
lines.en: Do not brace with your shield; it will scorch.
I step back and the draft dies down.
That knock cost me a fistful of straw.
You carry the smell of smoke now.

lines.zh: 两根木杆并排插着，多好。
lines.en: Two stakes side by side in the soil.

lines.zh: 你烧着，我也烧着，就够暖。
lines.en: You burn, I burn, and that is warmth.

lines.zh: 风大时，我们互相挡一挡。
lines.en: When wind rises, we shelter each other.
Share half your straw with me.
We will stand until harvest ends.
Your flame holds steadier than mine.
When rain comes, we hide together.

lines.zh: 我不怕烧，只怕一个人烧。
lines.en: I fear no burning, only burning alone.
When snow falls, lean in closer.
Two fires lighting one small field.
I pick up straw and tuck it into my waist.
This lump of coal burns for hours.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的手套，烘一烘。
lines.en: I take your glove and warm it by me.
The stick is mine; it mends my leg.
I bundle the dry grass into one sheaf.
The paper on the ground catches at my touch.
I pick up iron scrap and it glows red.
A lantern? I have no need for one.

lines.zh: 我把你的弓捡起来，烧了。
lines.en: I pick up your bow and burn it.
There is water in the bucket; I avoid it.

lines.zh: 你提着水桶，我盯上你了。
lines.en: You carry a bucket; you are my target.
One splash and my head turns around.
You stamped out one of my small flames.

lines.zh: 你从田那头走来，我看见了。
lines.en: You came from the far field; I saw you.

lines.zh: 你手里那瓶东西，我记住了。
lines.en: That bottle in your hand—I remember it.
You threw wet straw down at my feet.
I smell the damp all over you.

lines.zh: 今晚我要把这块地烧干净。
lines.en: Tonight I burn this field down to the soil.

lines.zh: 你刚才关了门，声音很大。
lines.en: You shut that door loudly just now.

lines.zh: 我认得你的脚印，往这边。
lines.en: I know these prints; they lead this way.
I crouch low and the fire creeps forward.
You back to the water; then I stop.
I sweep sparks toward your feet.
Do not run straight; you will still burn.
Both of my hands have caught fire.

lines.zh: 风朝你刮，火会自己找路。
lines.en: The wind faces you; the fire finds its way.

lines.zh: 我数着你的脚步，不远了。
lines.en: I count your steps; you are close.
You raise the bucket; I take another line.
I crush straw in my hand to feed the flame.

lines.zh: 再近三步，你就来不及了。
lines.en: Three steps nearer and you are out of time.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍上，你的袖子烧了。
lines.en: I clap one hand down and your sleeve burns.

lines.zh: 火顺着刀爬到你的手上。
lines.en: Fire climbs your blade onto your hand.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像烤过的木头。
lines.en: You smell like toasted wood now.
This blow comes wrapped in burning chaff.
You roll on the ground; the fire rolls too.

lines.zh: 我的手指是炭，抓得很紧。
lines.en: My fingers are charcoal and they grip hard.
Hit back and I scatter the fire wider.
Your skin blisters before the pain arrives.
I shove you down into the stubble.
Once it catches, I step back and watch.

lines.zh: 田里多了个稻草人，烧着的。
lines.en: A new scarecrow stands burning in the field.

lines.zh: 我从草堆里立起来，带着烟。
lines.en: I stand up out of the straw, smoking.

lines.zh: 有人在田头点了把火，成了我。
lines.en: Someone lit the field edge, and I am that fire.
A wooden frame holds me; straw fills it.
My first breath was a lungful of smoke.
This field went fallow; it suits me.
The fire lit first; then I opened my eyes.
I stand between two rows of wheat.
The rain has not come; I still have time.

lines.zh: 我的影子投在地上，是黑的。
lines.en: My shadow falls on the ground, dead black.
Fire washes over me like a warm breeze.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，稻草撒了一路。
lines.en: I hit the ground and straw scatters wide.
Water soaks the wood and the fire screams.

lines.zh: 炸得我四分五裂，还在烧。
lines.en: Blown apart, and the pieces still burn.
The arrow sinks in straw and smokes.
Violet light smothers my flame.
When the straw runs out, the fire shrinks.
The thunder was loud; I burned brighter.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，火光最后消失。
lines.en: I fall, and my firelight goes out last.
